note: A synthetic client (Slice 115 mock). Not a real company.
problem: We are an online home-goods retailer with our own warehouse. On-time shipping fell from 96% to 88% this year as orders grew from 4,000 to 6,500 a day. We need to decide whether to hire more pickers or invest in automation.

answers.common.decision: Hire or automate; the COO decides at the end of the quarter.
answers.common.audience: The COO and the finance lead.
answers.common.materials: We have 40 pickers. Each picker handles about 120 orders a day on average. A picker costs $52,000 a year fully loaded. A vendor quoted $1.8 million for a goods-to-person system that roughly doubles picks per worker.
answers.consulting.current-state: We already run two shifts. Peak season is November and December, when orders reach 9,000 a day.
answers.consulting.success: On-time shipping back above 95% through next peak.
answers.consulting.constraints: No new building; the system must fit in the current warehouse.
